newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA PUT SRI LANKA IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA PUT SRI LANKA IN TO BAT.

text.p: Australia won the toss and put
Sri Lanka in to bat in the Singer World Series tournament
The match was reduced to 35 overs after early morning rain
Australia - Ian Healy (captain), Michael Bevan, Damien
Flemming, Stuart Law, Glenn McGrath, Ricky Ponting, Michael
Slater, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Darren Lehmann, Paul Reiffel.
Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya,
Romesh Kaluwitharana, Asanka Gurusinha, Aravinda de Silva,
Hashan Tillekeratne, Roshan Mahanama, Kumara Dharmasena,
Chaminda Vaas, Muthiah Muralitharan, Upul Chandana.
